anomalies.observed: On the right-hand servo-signal block the two resistors that bridge the J9/J10 signal pins (pin 3) onto the shared MAX3485 bus node NET0033 — R220 and R180 — are drawn with no value (the value field is blank), whereas every other 0 Ω jumper on the sheet (R15, R7, R17, R24 of the PWM-select network) explicitly shows '0'. The 1 kΩ PWM-series parts (R13, R20) are present and correctly valued.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the serial-mode jumpers (R13/R14 in the reference design) as 0 Ω: 'R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus', with the schematic annotation 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo'. The two jumpers that tie the servo signal pins to the transceiver bus must therefore be 0 Ω.

anomalies.impact: In serial-servo mode the two servo signal pins are not low-resistance-bridged to the MAX3485 half-duplex bus (open or undefined series resistance instead of a 0 Ω jumper), so the shared TTL serial bus is broken and ID-addressed serial servos (RS304MD/RS30X) will not communicate reliably. PWM mode is unaffected because those jumpers are left open there.

parsed.summary: The build is functionally a renamed copy of the reference design (all rail/switch/transceiver values, the SS54 and PMEG3030EP diodes, the 4×100 µF + 0.1 µF caps, the 1 kΩ PWM series resistors and the four 0 Ω PWM-select jumpers all match the spec), but the two serial-mode 0 Ω jumpers (R220/R180) that bridge the servo signal pins to the MAX3485 bus are drawn without the required 0 Ω value, which would break serial-servo operation.
